summary: Phase 136AS independently verifies Phase 136AR's CompatibilityState typed record model (Typed Model Implementation Group 10) by completely re-deriving the contract directly from the live executable schema records/compatibility_state.schema.json and its shared component schemas -- deliberately not from Phase 136AR's own tests, fixtures, documentation, or canonical report. Independently re-derived: the 16 required fields; the local 2-value role enum {compatibility, historical}; the shared 6-value CompatibilityMode; the 7-value authority_role with 'authoritative' locally forbidden; both allOf/if/then/else conditionals (mode==legacy_retired <=> retirement_state present; mode in {legacy_historical, legacy_disabled, legacy_retired} => authority_role in {historical, compatibility}); the retirement_state empty-object-only pin (DEFERRED-136V-1); and the component/allowed_reads bounds. New standalone test module tests/test_cltr_authority_136as_compatibility_state_independent.py (188 tests: 186 fast + 2 packaging, all passing), independently fixtured, including an exhaustive schema-vs-model parity sweep across all 126 mode x authority_role x retirement_state combinations (zero mismatches -- the model neither weakens nor strengthens the executable schema). No Blocking defect was independently reproduced; NO production change was made (compatibility_quarantine.py is unmodified). In particular the retirement_state field, wrapped in the same general-purpose OpaqueJsonValue type whose field-agnostic contract caused the 136AQ staleness_check Blocking weakening (DEFERRED-136T-1), is already correctly narrowed to accept only {} at the field's own construction site. QuarantineRecord independently confirmed absent (not defined, exported, or importable) despite the compatibility_quarantine.py filename; exactly fifteen record-family models are exported. Regression: test_cltr_authority_136* + test_cltr_cutover_136* together 4456 passed / 4 failed (all four pre-existing/inherited stale scope/wheel guards -- test_136ab/test_136ad wheel-content, test_136m/test_136u schema-layer scope guards -- each reproduced identically with this phase's own new test file removed) / 9 skipped (-m "not slow"); Fast Green 4391 passed, 0 failed, matching the 136AM/136AO/136AP/136AQ/136AR-recorded baseline exactly; fresh wheel/sdist build plus isolated installation exercise confirmed all fifteen record-family models import and round-trip correctly with QuarantineRecord absent. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Verdict: COMPATIBILITYSTATE MODEL INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED WITH NO BLOCKING FINDING AND NO PRODUCTION CHANGE -- READY FOR QUARANTINERECORD IMPLEMENTATION.
